items.title: Claude reveals ECDSA curve origins
items.title_zh: Claude 破解 NIST ECDSA 曲线种子来源之谜
items.title_en: Claude traces NIST ECDSA curve seeds to lrand48 RNG
items.summary: Claude (or analysis inspired by the discovery) found that the NIST P-curve seeds were generated by the lrand48 C library RNG seeded with Unix timestamps, explaining their previously mysterious origins.

items.title: JPEG XL vs. AVIF for web use-cases
items.title_zh: Jake Archibald 对比 Web 场景下的 JPEG XL 与 AVIF
items.title_en: Jake Archibald compares JPEG XL and AVIF for web image use
items.summary: A comparative analysis of JPEG XL and AVIF image formats for web use, covering performance, file size, and quality, with community discussion on encoding efficiency and visual artifacts.

items.title: 90% of US working hours are spent on tasks not covered well by AI benchmarks
items.title_zh: Mercor：美国90%工时缺乏AI基准测试覆盖
items.title_en: Mercor: 90% of US Work Hours Lack AI Benchmark Coverage
items.summary: A Mercor labor-index analysis mapping AI benchmarks to O*NET tasks finds that ~90% of US working hours fall into tasks with little or no benchmark coverage, raising doubts about how well AI capability is measured against real work.

items.title: Big Fish: Exploiting a 37-Year-Old Kernel Bug in OpenBSD
items.title_zh: 研究人员利用存在37年之久的OpenBSD内核漏洞
items.summary: Security researchers detail exploiting a 37-year-old kernel bug in OpenBSD, highlighting the limits of code review in catching certain vulnerability classes.

items.title: Show HN: Gemini 4 Argon plays StarCraft
items.title_zh: Show HN：Gemini 4 Argon 在 StarSkirmish 基准 v0.2 中玩《星际争霸》
items.title_en: Show HN: Gemini 4 Argon Plays StarCraft in StarSkirmish Bench v0.2
items.summary: StarSkirmish Bench v0.2 ranks flagship LLMs by having them play StarCraft: Brood War through code generation, sparking discussion on multi-agent benchmarking and AI planning.

items.title: 可灵 Kling 4.0 全量上线
items.title_zh: 可灵 Kling 4.0 全量上线，接入 MCP/CLI 并预告 4K HDR 输出
items.title_en: Kling 4.0 Rolls Out Fully with MCP/CLI and 4K HDR Output
items.summary: Kling 4.0 is fully launched on klingai.com with an upgraded creation page, planned 4K/10-bit HDR output, and upcoming MCP/CLI and enterprise API access.
